proposed_sites.reason: Module-level namespaced call pattern openai.ChatCompletion.create(...) is removed in v1; must migrate to a client-based call like client.chat.completions.create(...) (migration rule #2).

considered_and_rejected.reason: This only reads the env var into a local variable; it is never assigned to openai.api_key or any other module-level openai attribute anywhere in the repo, so migration rule #1 (bare module-level attribute assignment) does not apply. The SDK's automatic pickup of the OPENAI_API_KEY env var is unaffected by this migration's scope.
Bare import statement, not a call site; no code change is mandated at the import line itself under any of the three migration rules.
